meta.title: Classic Scandinavia w/ Fjords | NordisTravel
meta.description: Embark on an extraordinary 8-day summer journey through Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Sweden. Discover Copenhagen, Oslo, Flåm, Bergen, Helsinki, and Stockholm on a premium, curated Scandinavian vacation.

hero.subtitle: Denmark, Norway, Finland & Sweden:
hero.title: Classic Scandinavia with Fjords
hero.description: Discover the magic of Northern Europe on a premium, curated journey through spectacular Norwegian fjords and vibrant Nordic capitals.

map_deck.title: THE MAP DECK
map_deck.description: Visualize your premium journey across Denmark, Norway, Finland, and Sweden.

steps.title: Denmark Capital
steps.description: Start in historic Copenhagen. Stroll Nyhavn, visit royal palaces, and cruise overnight across the sea to Norway.

steps.title: Norway Fjordlands
steps.description: Cross into Norway. Journey through Gol, cruise the breathtaking Aurlandsfjord, and ride the iconic Flåm Railway.

steps.title: Bergen Wharf
steps.description: Explore Bergen's Bryggen wharf, ride the Fløibanen funicular, and fly over Sweden to Finland.

steps.title: Helsinki Harbor
steps.description: Tour Helsinki's unique Rock Church, Uspenski Cathedral, and cruise overnight to Sweden.

steps.title: Sweden Entrance
steps.description: Explore the historic Vasa Museum, Stockholm City Hall, and depart from Stockholm.

itinerary.title: Welcome to Denmark
itinerary.vibe_text: Arrive in Denmark's charming capital. Check into your hotel and enjoy a relaxing evening at leisure.

highlights.title: Arrival & Transfer
highlights.description: Arrive at Copenhagen Airport by flight, pick up, and transfer to your hotel.

highlights.title: Leisure Time
highlights.description: Enjoy a free afternoon to relax and explore the surrounding neighborhood.

itinerary.title: Royalty, Canals & Seaside Mermaids
itinerary.vibe_text: Explore Copenhagen's historic palaces and iconic Nyhavn canals before boarding your premium overnight cruise to Norway.

highlights.title: Copenhagen City Tour
highlights.description: Visit the Little Mermaid statue, Gefion Fountain, Amalienborg Palace (outside), Nyhavn, and the City Hall.

highlights.title: Baltic Cruise Boarding
highlights.description: Transfer to the Go Nordic Cruise Terminal and check in to your sea view cabin.

highlights.title: Grand Buffet Dinner
highlights.description: Celebrate the evening with a massive dinner buffet on board as you cruise overnight to Oslo.

itinerary.stay: 🏨 Stay: Overnight Cruise Sea View Cabin (Go Nordic Cruiseline)

itinerary.title: From Fjordlands to Alpine Peaks
itinerary.vibe_text: Arrive in Oslo and transfer deep into the Norwegian highlands, ending with a spectacular 2-hour fjord cruise from Flåm to Gudvangen.

highlights.title: Oslo Port to Gol
highlights.description: Arrive at Oslo Port, board your long-distance coach, and drive to Gol for a 3-course lunch at Pers Hotell.

highlights.title: Transfer to Flåm
highlights.description: Continue on a scenic highland drive towards the village of Flåm.

highlights.title: Spectacular Fjord Cruise
highlights.description: Board a 2-hour cruise from Flåm to Gudvangen to experience the dramatic cliffs of the Nærøyfjord.

itinerary.title: The Legendary Rail & Waterfront Wharf
itinerary.vibe_text: Ride the iconic Flåm Railway loop up steep mountain canyons, then transfer to Bergen for city sightseeing and Bryggen wharf views.

highlights.title: The Legendary Flåm Railway
highlights.description: Embark on the world-famous return train journey from Flåm to Myrdal, ascending over 800 meters.

highlights.title: Fjord-Side Lunch
highlights.description: Savor a buffet lunch at Flåmsbrygga Hotel / Flåmstova Restaurant.

highlights.title: Bergen City Tour & Funicular
highlights.description: Drive to Bergen. Tour the Bryggen wharf, visit the Bergen Fish Market, and ride the Fløibanen funicular for city views.

slides.title: The Flåm Railway
slides.caption: Ride the historic train loop up steep cliffs.

slides.title: Bergen Bryggen Wharf
slides.caption: See the iconic colorful wooden houses on the canal.

itinerary.title: Crossing the Baltic Airspace
itinerary.tagline: ✈️ Bergen to Helsinki: Welcome to Finland
itinerary.vibe_text: Depart Norway on a short flight to Helsinki, Finland. Transfer to the city center and check in to your premium seaside hotel.

highlights.title: Flight to Helsinki
highlights.description: Transfer to Bergen airport and board your flight to Helsinki, Finland.

highlights.title: City Center Transfer
highlights.description: Arrive at Helsinki airport and drive to your downtown hotel.

highlights.title: Seaside Lodging
highlights.description: Check in and enjoy dinner at your premium seaside hotel.

itinerary.title: Rock Churches, Cathedrals & Baltic Cruise
itinerary.tagline: 🇫🇮 Helsinki Highlights & Silja Line Overnight Cruise
itinerary.vibe_text: Tour Helsinki's architectural marvels, including the Rock Church, before setting sail on a premium overnight cruise to Stockholm.

highlights.title: Helsinki Monuments
highlights.description: Photo stop at Uspenski Cathedral, entrance to Temppeliaukio Rock Church, and a 3-course lunch at Ravintola Zetor.

highlights.title: Market Square Shopping
highlights.description: Visit Senate Square, the Market Square, and shop at the historic Stockmann mall.

highlights.title: Silja Line Cruise
highlights.description: Transfer to Silja Line Terminal, check in to your A-Class sea view cabin, and enjoy the grand dinner buffet on board.

itinerary.stay: 🏨 Stay: Overnight Cruise Sea View Cabin (Tallink Silja Line)

itinerary.title: Venice of the North & Majestic Warships
itinerary.vibe_text: Sail into Stockholm and tour the historic capital, visiting the world-famous Vasa Museum and the grand Stockholm City Hall.

highlights.title: Stockholm City Tour
highlights.description: Arrive Stockholm port and begin city sightseeing with your Tour Leader.

highlights.title: Vasa Museum & City Hall
highlights.description: Entrance to Vasa Museum to see the 17th-century warship, and guided tour of Stockholm City Hall.

highlights.title: Agaton Swedish Lunch
highlights.description: Enjoy a 3-course lunch at Restaurang Agaton, followed by hotel transfer.

itinerary.title: Farewell Northern Europe
itinerary.vibe_text: Enjoy your final Swedish breakfast before transferring to the airport for your flight back home, carrying a lifetime of Baltic memories.

highlights.title: Last Morning
highlights.description: Enjoy breakfast at your hotel followed by last-minute souvenir shopping at leisure.

highlights.title: Airport Transfer
highlights.description: Coach transfer from Scandic Victoria Tower to Stockholm airport.

highlights.title: Return Flight
highlights.description: Arrive at the airport, check in, and board your flight home.

parallax_sections.title: Cruise Across the Oslofjord
parallax_sections.subtitle: Dine, relax, and wake up in Norway.

booking.title: Secure Your Classic Scandinavia Journey
booking.description: Book your premium summer adventure today. Our package includes coach transits, rail passes, intra-tour flight (Bergen ➔ Helsinki), overnight cruise cabins, hotels, highlight meals, and professional tour leadership.
bullets: All Premium Hotels & Cruise Cabins Included

value_insights.title: VALUE INSIGHTS
value_insights.description: Premium value and total transparency. Here is exactly what is included in your tour.
inclusions: Hotel Stays: 5 nights in premium hotels (Scandic Sluseholmen, Fretheim Hotel, Scandic Bergen City, Scandic Grand Marina, Scandic Victoria Tower) in standard double room sharing.
Baltic Cruises: 2 nights in overnight cruises (Copenhagen ➔ Oslo and Helsinki ➔ Stockholm) in standard 2/4-bed cabins with buffet dinners included.
Transit Flights: One-way flight ticket from Bergen to Helsinki (economy class, standard luggage).
Meals: 7 breakfasts, 3 premium lunches (Gol, Flåm, Stockholm), 4 dinners (including cruise buffets).
Activities & Excursions: Flåm Railway ticket, 2-hour fjord cruise, Vasa Museum entry, Rock Church entry, and guided city tours in Copenhagen, Bergen, Helsinki, and Stockholm.
exclusions: Personal shopping, souvenirs, and optional sightseeing activities.
Lunches and dinners not explicitly detailed in the itinerary.
Individual international flights to Copenhagen and from Stockholm.

footer.description: Providing premium, authentic travel experiences across the spectacular landscapes of Scandinavia and the Baltic capitals. Our team organizes every detail so you can focus on making memories.
